question: What is the meaning of indicators and assessment in relation to product labels and certification?
description:
Indicators and assessment in relation to product labels and certification refer to the criteria and metrics used to evaluate the environmental performance of products. These indicators are used to assign a label or certification to the product, indicating its sustainability level or compliance with certain environmental standards. The assessment process involves analyzing the product's life cycle, from resource extraction to disposal, and evaluating its environmental impact based on the selected indicators. This process helps manufacturers, consumers, and third-party certifiers to make informed decisions about the sustainability and environmental friendliness of products. <|ENDINPUT>
